fields.title: 📖 Holding One’s Soul to Account
fields.body:
🖋️ **Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** رحمه الله, one of the Tābiʿīn, said in meaning:

“The believer **keeps watch over himself** and *holds himself to account for the sake of Allāh.*

The reckoning on the Day of Resurrection will be **easier** for those who *held themselves to account in this worldly life.*

**The reckoning will be harder**, however, for those who went about their affairs *without examining themselves.*”

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Training one’s own soul** begins with *sincere self-examination*. Whoever **recognizes his mistakes**, *restrains his desires*, and holds himself to account strives for **purification of his soul** and obedience to Allāh.
